biocontainers.name: bioconductor-rhdf5filters
biocontainers.summary: Provides a collection of compression filters for use with HDF5 datasets.

biotools.summary: Provides a collection of additional compression filters for HDF5 datasets. The package is intended to provide seamless integration with rhdf5, however the compiled filters can also be used with external applications.
